description: At-a-glance health of the monitored host and the Prometheus stack. Tailored to this repo's alert rules.

panels.title: CPU Busy
panels.description: Percentage of CPU time not spent idle, averaged across all cores.

panels.title: RAM Used
panels.description: Memory in use, based on MemAvailable (excludes reclaimable cache).

panels.title: CPU Package Temp
panels.description: CPU package temperature. Red at 85 °C matches the HighAverageCPUTemperature alert.

panels.title: Firing Alerts
panels.description: Number of Prometheus alerts currently in the firing state.

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: Load above the dashed CPU-core count means work is queuing.

panels.title: Disk I/O Throughput
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: Network Traffic
panels.description: Receive above the axis, transmit below. Interfaces filtered by the $nic variable.

panels.title: Active Alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerts that are pending or firing. Empty is good.

panels.title: Scrape Targets
panels.description: Health of every Prometheus scrape target.

panels.title: TSDB Head Series
panels.description: Number of active time series held in Prometheus memory.

list.name: nic
list.label: Network interfaces
list.description: Regex of physical NICs to show (excludes docker/veth/bridge interfaces).

title: Host Overview
